title: mimi-mls: Member::commit exports GroupInfo
description: Found in .4.7: Member::commit returns CommitBundle.group_info == None with the current OpenMLS config, so a mimi-mls committer cannot produce the GroupInfo signature a PartialGroupInfo needs (needed by .5.10/.5.11 update requests). Enable GroupInfo export in the commit builder and add a consistency test: Member commits, Observer rebuilds via group_info(partial), bytes equal Member's GroupInfo.
